enabled.description: Enable or disable the corosync_notifyd service.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Events at this level and above will be logged.

corosync_config.description: Path to the main corosync configuration file. Usually auto-detected, but you can override it.

notifications.description: List of notification configurations, each targeting a specific event type (e.g., node join, quorum loss). Each entry defines how to notify on that event.

type.description: The event type to notify on (e.g., 'node_join', 'quorum_loss', 'resource_failed').

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the notification purpose.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this specific notification type.

backend.description: Backend to use for delivering the notification: email, syslog, or execute a command.

smtp_use_tls.description: Use TLS for SMTP connection (only for 'email' backend).

facility.description: Syslog facility to use (only for 'syslog' backend).

command.description: Shell command to execute on event (only for 'exec' backend). Supports environment variable substitution like ${EVENT_TYPE}.

environment.description: Environment variables to set when executing the command (only for 'exec' backend).

rate_limit.description: Global rate-limiting settings to prevent notification storms.

max_events.description: Maximum number of notifications allowed per time window.
